answer: One account, one record, one voyage: that is the whole defence. A farm would have to deliver 1,100 real bark loads to 1,100 real tanneries, while one driver delivers a single load. The hollow is the quiet part of the proof. A bark delivery docket is stamped at the tannery gate with the cart count, the bark weight, and the supplier name. Without the atlas, the claim is only words.
